route: Fai della Paganella - Pieve di Soligo

intermediate.name: Muro di Ca' del Poggio
intermediate.title: KOM Sprint (4) Muro di Ca' del Poggio (161.7 km)

story: Four riders break away early, with Lidl-Trek controlling the peloton. Attacks by Afonso Eulálio and Jonas Vingegaard cause a split on the final climb, but the race reunites. Paul Magnier wins the bunch sprint after a strong lead-out from Jasper Stuyven.
